features.name: Phase 3 red-team stress engine
features.summary: Builds a deterministic per-project audit with six dimensions, baseline identity, hypothetical composite (mean not max), non-causal sensitivity ranking and aggregate metrics.

features.name: Reference-area selection sensitivity
features.summary: Re-evaluates each project's LOPO prediction under other regions/countries from the benchmark.

features.name: Baseline temporal elasticity (+/-1 year horizon)
features.summary: Shifts the certified baseline horizon by one year and recomputes the certified annual claim component.
features.registry_match: Stress tests for baselines and leakage

features.name: Baseline model-form sensitivity
features.summary: Compares gradient boosting with a linear-in-claim alternative; saturating forms are deliberately not implemented.
features.registry_match: Stress tests for baselines and leakage

features.name: Leakage-rate uncertainty dimension
features.summary: Emits NaN rows marked NOT SUPPORTED WITH CURRENT DATA for every project; no leakage stress is computed.

features.name: Measurement uncertainty (+/-1 SE of independent estimate)
features.summary: Perturbs the independent counterfactual mean by +/-1 standard error only; remote-sensing measurement error is not modelled.

features.name: Carbon-stock uncertainty dimension
features.summary: Placeholder that documents no per-project carbon-stock uncertainty is available and returns NaN rows; no stress is applied.

features.name: Canonical JSON SHA-256 audit integrity
features.summary: Deterministic canonicalization, per-project and bundle digests, and tamper verification.

features.name: Phase 2 ElasticNet and shallow gradient-boosting models
features.summary: Regularized models with fixed hyperparameters predicting annualized claim-vs-independent discrepancy (ha/yr) on 44 projects.

features.name: LOPO/LOCO validation, bootstrap CIs, permutation importance

features.name: Ex-ante/ex-post leakage guard
features.summary: Feature whitelist and forbidden-column validation prevent ex-post data entering model inputs; partitioner and leakage audit support it.

features.name: Data loaders, schema validators and provenance tracking
features.summary: CSV/Excel loader with file hashing, pydantic ex-ante/ex-post schemas, no-synthetic-value validation and provenance log.

features.name: Zenodo download, 44-project benchmark generation, project-area derivation
features.summary: Downloads the Swinfield et al. dataset, applies published eligibility rules with a Supplementary Table 1 cross-check, and derives project areas.
